BioIntel Demo
Infection reference page
BioIntel demonstration record 4. The compound ciprofloxacin was discussed with target gyrA in the context of bacterial infection. The example mutation is S83L. A demonstration MIC measurement of 317 nM is shown for Escherichia coli. Synthetic reference labels: SYN-PAPER-0004 and SYN-DOI-NOT-REAL-0004.
